notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone !
This update is a special update. We were ready to provide as much help and support as possible to the game when it released, and we did our best providing a (almost) stable experience.
 
Beyond Dimensions is a game about breaking the limits, evolving going further than what is reasonable. So you have probably encountered weird behaviour, but no problematic behaviour. So, we were ready to help you not getting stuck or having a bad experience with the game.

This didn't happen. We got very to no little glitch feedback.

So, for this update, there are only two bugfixes :
- Smoother building collision to prevent the player being blocked in the dinosaur city.
- Lighter fireball effect in FPS mode, as this froze the game for about 0.2 seconds.

It would be too sad to only update this ! So :

- New customizable character
- New stories

notes.title: Patch V1.2
notes.content:
Here's another patch !

Quick Restart button when you've lost, to avoid having to reread a story, click new game, create a new character... Get back in action right away instead !

difficulty selection ; Beyond Dimensions requires a lot of attention and knowledge about the game. The original difficulty is too hard for newcomers to get used to the game.  Playing easy mode only locks the leaderboard. You still can unlock game modes, characters, spells, and achievements.

New screen to configure your game ; After creating your character, a new screen appears, letting you more easily configure FPS mode, Power mode, generation seed and difficulty.

The player now attracts power ups when they are close to them.

Made the main menu easier to read for controller users.

Added a Workshop button to the character selection, as a shortcut to download skins.

Engine update.

Hope you'll enjoy the udpate !

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone, hope you're enjoying the game !

Here's what's changed/added

Controller support (needs configuration in the controls menu)
French texts in the english version removed
Added a "Push any key to continue" to allow people to read the loading tips.
Energy Blade can now be held.
Spelling mistakes removed.
Changed the "change sex" icon for a "change skin" icon.
Silhouette activating system modified for better performance.
Changed some tutorial texts to avoid confusion between "second spell" and "middle spell", and better explanation of the mana system.
Set a maximal lifetime for fireballs.
New unlocking screen, clearer.
Made skin selection easier.
Changed the mode selection to be red, to be more visible.

And, after some reports of 4th world glitches : 

optimized visuals in world 4
lowered pathfinding quality for the 4th world final bosses (it shouldn't be noticable as the level isn't that complicated)
